verdicts.matching_evidence: In Section 2.3.1, the authors calculate the maximum baseline length $L$ required to treat the Sun as a point source. They state: "we select baselines with $\theta > 1^\circ$... the baseline length $L$ should ideally not exceed 45.8 m to satisfy this requirement." This arithmetic is incorrect. At a wavelength of $\lambda = 0.4$ m (750 MHz), a baseline of $L = 45.8$ m yields an angular resolution of $\theta = 0.4 / 45.8 \approx 0.00873$ radians, which is exactly $0.5^\circ$, not $1^\circ$.
